glosses: Inflected to express plea, insistence, imploring, self-encouragement, wish, desire, intent, command, purpose, or consequence.

examples.text: The ministration of these oracles from the pulpit is to be reformed from any of its factitious peculiarities, and made again what it was among the apostles and their immediate successors—earnest, simple, powerful address—hortative talk, if we may so call it.

glosses: Of a mood or class of imperative subjunctive moods of a verb for giving strong encouragement.
A mood or class of imperative subjunctive moods of a verb for giving strong encouragement.
Mode grammatical qui sert à exprimer un engagement de la personne qui parle. Il est employé en hébreu.

examples.text: Comme nous le verrons plus bas, pour dire «je veux y aller» le rédacteur aurait utilisé un cohortatif direct avec suite.

glosses: Gebrauchsweise des Konjunktivs als Aufforderung an die eigene Person
